annotations.title: Start/Sit by the Market — what Kalshi prices each player at

description: Use for "should I start Nacua or Adams" and "who does the market like more this week". For 2–4 players: the median Kalshi is pricing for each stat (read off his own strike ladder) and his anytime-TD price, compared on the stats they share. Market prices only — the call stays yours; Pro adds our weekly projection.

players.description: Two to four player names, e.g. ["Puka Nacua", "Davante Adams"] or "Nacua, Adams".
